title: Channel Operations Specialist/CMT (Customer Support)
description:
**Company Description**

​

RAKwireless is a leading innovator in the Internet of Things (IoT) industry, dedicated to simplifying design complexities and accelerating time-to-market through its modular IoT solutions. Established in 2014 and headquartered in Shenzhen, China, the company operates R&D centers in Beijing and Xi'an and maintains strategic partnerships across Asia, Europe, and the Americas.

Driven by its "IoT Made Easy" philosophy, RAKwireless delivers high-performance, energy-efficient, and easy-to-deploy solutions for developers, system integrators, and IoT solution providers across a wide range of industries. Through its innovative hardware components and unified software ecosystem, RAKwireless aims to eliminate connectivity and interoperability barriers, empowering both emerging and established markets.

Join a dynamic IoT company that values collaboration, process excellence, and operational efficiency. If you enjoy organizing, supporting partners, and ensuring smooth execution of initiatives, this could be the perfect role for you!

**What You'll Do:**

* Support the rollout of new initiatives and programs for channel partners
* Coordinate partner requests, inquiries, and support tickets to ensure timely resolution
* Maintain communication and follow-ups with partners to foster strong relationships
* Prepare reports and track key operational metrics
* Collaborate with internal teams to improve processes and support business objectives
* Help manage schedules and ensure timely execution of partner-related activities

**What We're Looking For:**

* Strong communication skills: Clear and professional English (spoken and written)
* Organized and detail-oriented: Able to manage multiple tasks and priorities effectively
* Customer/partner-focused: Able to provide excellent support and maintain positive relationships
* Tech-savvy: Comfortable using CRM platforms or partner management systems, with hands-on experience in Zen-desk or similar ticketing platforms
* Problem-solving skills: Able to handle requests and issues efficiently
* Prior experience in channel operations, partner support, or related roles is preferred (2+ years)
* Self-motivated and proactive: Able to work independently and suggest improvements

and

5 days working. Sat & Sun fixed off

title: Future Talent - Junior Analyst
description:
*At Tetra Pak we commit to making food safe and available, everywhere; and we protect what's good – protecting food, protecting people, and protecting the planet. By doing so we touch millions of people's lives every day.*
*And we need people like you to make it happen.*
***We empower you to reach your potential with opportunities to make an impact to be proud of – for food, people and the planet.***
**About Future Talent Program**
Future Talent Program is a Trainee Program within Tetra Pak. We offer a permanent position from start in July 2026. You will onboard an individual designed development program for 24 months connected to a specific position and the Tetra Pak organization. During the program you will participate in trainings and job rotations throughout various parts of Tetra Pak to explore your potential and grow as a person.
  
  
As a Trainee here with us, you will get to know our entire business and collaborate with colleagues all over the world. And this is just the beginning of your Tetra Pak career!
  
  
From day one you will be delivering results as a true team member following a development plan that is specifically designed for you and your position. The plan includes a combination of project-rotations, international assignments, work within your own department as well as formal training and mentorship from a network of colleagues all over the world. The program will give you broad insight into our company, our culture and our values. After completing this program, you will have gained knowledge, built relationships, and had experiences to help you continue your exciting career within our company.
  
  
**Future Talent Program-OTM**
We are looking for a talented recent graduated who has creative and innovative thinking, problem-solving skills with personal initiative, who demonstrates a passion for applying theoretical learning to face challenges. Current, with strong communication skills and who are committed to being true team players.
  
  
This is an opportunity to be part of the OTM ( Oracle Transportation Management) that will enable Tetra Pak to be successful now and in the future. The mission of the OTM team is to enable governed, trustable, and quality Service. It is a cross functional and diverse team that interfaces with all business units of the enterprise. You will get the opportunity to become an expert in a growing work area and on market leading solutions.
  
  
To be successful in this role you need to be a team player and have the ability to build trust on all levels. Furthermore, you have a strong drive, are result oriented and have an interest for both business and tech. You have easy to see the big picture but also have attention to details and care about quality.
  
  
You are comfortable with communication, explaining new concepts and helping others to understand. You should be able to work independently and be eager to find new and creative solutions to challenges.
  
  
The program starts on 1st July 2026.
  
  
**Job Summary**
Tetra Pak Global Information Management (Global IM) supports the Tetra Pak Group with all aspects of Information Management. We set the information management strategy and standards and work together with Tetra Pak’s Global Process Owners to automate our business processes making sure we run projects & services that provide the greatest value for Tetra Pak and its customers. Global IM has approx. 900 employees in four main sites: Chakan in India, Lund in Sweden, Denton in the USA and in Singapore.
  
  
Tetra Pak Global Information Management is currently seeking an analyst who can demonstrate strong understanding and hands on experience on logistics and transportation industry to join the “business-IT” in
**Order Fulfillment Packaging Material**
related Projects and Service Delivery Team (SDT). Team members work as a pool of resources with assignments to
**Oracle Transport Management**
related projects, GAPs (small developments) and service support activities as driven by demands from the business.
  
  
This is a permanent position, based in Chakan, India.
  
  
**What You Will Do**
As Tetra Pak’s new IT Analyst resource you will be working on various business applications to support Tetra Pak´s core business units. These business applications will be based on the
**Oracle technology**
on
**Oracle Transport Management System**
. The OTM team members are mostly located in Chakan and in Singapore. Hence meetings and phone calls can occur outside normal business hours.
  
  

* You will work with information flow of a specific Business Process end to end, being able to identify any impact of business processes and IT Services in relation to new business requirements and IT solutions.
* You will work to support project team members and work with continuous improvement gaps, project pre-study preparations and design ideas.
* You will be expected to lead various small work team e.g. gap lead, application specialist (application lead), test lead, etc. As needed, we wish for you to be a backup / assistant Subject Matter Expert (SME) and to assist the Solution Architect and or Service Architect. In this assistant SME role, you will co-lead/lead discussions with the business and or technical team members and provided needed solutioning and guidance.

**We believe you have**

* You have a university degree or a diploma from a business or engineering course of study.
* You have 1 - 2 years’ work experience in Logistic and Transport management areas and a very good understanding of the complete end-to-end supply chain.
* You have a personal drive, you are curious, would like to learn new things and drive the future.
* You are result-oriented.
* You are strong analytical.
* You have good communication skills.
* You enjoy working in a team.
* You have a very good command of English Language
* Functional and Technical knowledge of relevant Transport systems is a plus.
* Some Experience some Transport Mgt. system or ERP implementation and business analysis and support is a plus.
* Good to have experience or training on:

+ Any ERP solutions
+ MS SQL Dbase
+ Excel
+ Other MS office tools

**We Offer You**

* A variety of exciting challenges with ample opportunities for development and training in a truly global landscape
* A culture that pioneers a spirit of innovation where our industry experts drive visible results
* An equal opportunity employment experience that values diversity and inclusion
* Market competitive compensation and benefits with flexible working arrangements

**Apply Now**
If you are inspired to be part of our promise to protect what’s good; for food, people, and the planet, apply through our careers page at https://jobs.tetrapak.com/.
  
  
This job posting expires on
**27-04-2026.**
If you have any questions about your application, please contact
**Tanvi Maheshwari**
.
  
  
*Diversity, equity, and inclusion is an everyday part of how we work. We give people a place to belong and support to thrive, an environment where everyone can be comfortable being themselves and has equal opportunities to grow and succeed. We embrace difference, celebrate people for who they are, and for the diversity they bring that helps us better understand and connect with our customers and communities worldwide.*

title: ERP NAV Functional Consultant

· Contribute to project teams through workshops and ERP implementations.

· Train users in new processes and Dynamics NAV functionality.

· Develop data conversion and testing strategies.

· Experience with ISV products such as Charge Logic, Lanham E-Ship, Scribe Insight and Jet Reports a plus.

· Functional knowledge of finance, distribution, and production granules; Other areas of functionality such as CRM, Projects, MRP and WMS is a plus.

· Minimum 4 years’ hands-on experience with full life-cycle implementations.

· Previous ERP implementation experience is required.

· Knowledge of best practices, principles and procedures as related to small-to-mid-size business processes.

· Ability to understand, communicate on all levels in an organization, interpret client business processes and requirements.

· Ability to thrive in a collaborative atmosphere.

· Excellent organizational skills with the ability to balance multiple demands.

· Proven ability to write effective system and process documentation, including business and system requirements, process diagrams, and data flow charts.

· Fluency in English, both written and verbal is required.

· Ability to establish priorities, work independently and proceed with objectives without detailed supervision.

title: Field Engineer
description:
**Company Description** 
 Elecom India is a specialized provider of elevator displays, IP communication solutions, COP/LOP panels, video walls, and people\-counting systems. The company offers comprehensive maintenance and repair services for a wide range of elevator electronic devices, ensuring reliability and safety for customers. In addition to products and services, Elecom India provides technical consultancy to help clients optimize their elevator and telecom systems. With over 15 years of experience in the elevator and telecom fields, the organization combines strong domain expertise with practical, on\-ground service capabilities.
 



**Role Description** 
 This is a full\-time, on\-site Field Engineer role based in Vasai. The Field Engineer will install, configure, and commission elevator electronic devices, including displays, communication systems, and control panels, at customer locations. Responsibilities include diagnosing and repairing hardware and electronic faults, performing preventive maintenance, and ensuring systems operate safely and efficiently. The role involves visiting customer sites, documenting service activities, preparing basic technical reports, and coordinating with the internal support and operations teams. The Field Engineer will also provide technical guidance to clients, assist in system upgrades, and follow all safety and quality standards during field work.
 



**Qualifications** 



* Strong knowledge of electronics, electrical systems, and basic networking relevant to elevator and telecom equipment.
* Experience with installation, maintenance, and troubleshooting of electronic devices, panels, displays, and communication systems.
* Ability to read and interpret technical drawings, wiring diagrams, and equipment manuals.
* Good problem\-solving skills, attention to detail, and ability to manage time and multiple field assignments effectively.
* Diploma or degree in Electrical, Electronics, Telecommunication, or related engineering discipline.
* Comfort working on\-site at customer locations, including travel within the region as required.
* Clear and professional communication skills for interacting with customers and internal teams.
* Prior experience in elevator or telecom service and field engineering is an advantage.

title: Customer Support Executive
description:
**Company Description** 
 LenDenClub is one of India’s largest peer\-to\-peer lending platforms, offering alternate financial instruments that help individuals grow their wealth beyond traditional options. As an RBI\-registered NBFC\-P2P, the company emphasizes trust, transparency, and technology to ensure secure, compliant, and seamless transactions. By listing pre\-verified loans, LenDenClub enables lenders to earn attractive returns while diversifying their portfolios. With over 4 crore registered users and more than ₹20,000 crore lent, LenDenClub plays a key role in India’s fintech revolution and credit growth story. Built on innovation and inclusion, the platform continues to expand as a trusted wealth growth partner for people across India.
 



**Role Description** 




  





 This is a full\-time, on\-site Customer Support Executive role based in Goregaon. The role involves responding to customer inquiries via phone, email, chat, and other online support channels, ensuring prompt and accurate resolution of issues. The Customer Support Executive will handle account\-related queries, guide users through platform features, troubleshoot basic technical problems, and escalate complex issues to the appropriate teams. Daily responsibilities include documenting interactions, tracking recurring concerns, maintaining high customer satisfaction, and providing feedback to improve processes and user experience. The role also requires collaborating with internal teams such as operations, product, and technical support to ensure a smooth customer journey.
 



  





**Qualifications** 



* Candidates should possess strong Customer Support and Customer Service skills, with a focus on empathy, clarity, and problem\-solving.
* Candidates should possess skills related to Customer Satisfaction, including the ability to manage expectations, handle complaints, and follow up on resolutions.
* Candidates should possess Online Support experience, such as handling queries across chat, email, and social or app\-based channels.
* Candidates should possess Technical Support capabilities to troubleshoot basic platform issues and coordinate with technical teams for advanced concerns.
* Strong verbal and written communication skills in English; proficiency in additional Indian languages is an advantage.
* Ability to work in a fast\-paced fintech environment, with attention to detail and accuracy in customer communication.
* Prior experience in financial services, fintech, or customer\-facing roles is preferred but not mandatory.
* Minimum qualification: Graduate degree in any discipline; relevant certifications in customer support or communication are a plus.
